thresholds.source: Espressif ESP32-S3 datasheet (recommended VDD 3.0-3.6V, VIH=0.75*VDD, VIL=0.25*VDD): https://documentation.espressif.com/esp32-s3_datasheet_en.html; EN must be released after 3V3 is stable
Espressif ESP32-S3 datasheet (recommended VDD 3.0-3.6V, VIH=0.75*VDD, VIL=0.25*VDD): https://documentation.espressif.com/esp32-s3_datasheet_en.html

notes: EN rises to VIH ~13.9 ms after 3V3 starts; with the ESP32-S3 internal ~45k pull-up (ASSUMPTION) it is ~11.3 ms. Both are well inside the allowed power-up window; the RC also keeps EN low while 3V3 ramps. Reset button shorts EN to GND. Internal pull-up value is an assumption.
